facts.statement: Teleidosaurus was an extinct carnivorous marine crocodile relative found in Middle Jurassic deposits of Normandy, France.
facts.quote: Teleidosaurus is an extinct genus of carnivorous metriorhynchoid crocodyliform from Middle Jurassic (late Bajocian to early Bathonian stage) deposits of Normandy, France.

facts.statement: The name Teleidosaurus means "complete lizard" and comes from Greek words for complete and lizard.
facts.quote: The name Teleidosaurus means "Complete lizard", and is derived from the Greek - ("complete") and σαῦρος -sauros ("lizard").

facts.statement: Jacques Amand Eudes-Deslongchamps named the type species in 1866, but his son Eugène Eudes-Deslongchamps established the genus name Teleidosaurus in 1869.
facts.quote: The type species was named Teleosaurus Calvadosii [Sic] by Jacques Amand Eudes-Deslongchamps in 1866; however, it was his son, Eugène Eudes-Deslongchamps who erected the generic name Teleidosaurus later in 1869 for Teleosaurus calvadosii.

facts.statement: Teleidosaurus is classified as a non-metriorhynchid metriorhynchoid because it mixes metriorhynchid skull features with ancestral thalattosuchian traits in its lower jaw.
facts.quote: Once considered a metriorhynchid, Teleidosaurus was later recovered as non-metriorhynchid metriorhynchoid, as its skull possesses some anatomical aspects of metriorhynchids, but also retains some ancestral thalattosuchian characteristics, specially on the lower jaw.

facts.statement: Recent phylogenetic analyses suggest that the genus Teleidosaurus is not a monophyletic group.
facts.quote: Phylogenetic analyses do not support the monophyly of Teleidosaurus.

facts.statement: Teleidosaurus lived during the late Bajocian to early Bathonian stages of the Middle Jurassic in Normandy, France.
facts.quote: Teleidosaurus is an extinct genus of carnivorous metriorhynchoid crocodyliform from Middle Jurassic (late Bajocian to early Bathonian stage) deposits of Normandy, France.

facts.statement: Teleidosaurus is the most basal genus of marine crocodyliforms within the superfamily Metriorhynchoidea, known from the Bajocian and Bathonian periods of the Middle Jurassic.
facts.quote: Teleidosaurus es el género de crocodiliforme marino más basal dentro de la superfamilia Metriorhynchoidea, y es conocido de los períodos Bajociano y Bathoniense del Jurásico Medio.

facts.statement: The time range for Teleidosaurus spans from the Bajocian to the Kimmeridgian, between 168.6 and 152.21 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Kimmeridgian (168.6 to 152.21 million years ago)

facts.statement: Teleidosaurus joberti is considered a junior synonym of the type species T. calvadosii.
facts.quote: Teleidosaurus joberti from the Great Oolite Formation is a junior synonym of T. calvadosii.

facts.statement: The species T. bathonicus and T. gaudryi were reassigned to the genus Eoneustes.
facts.quote: Tanto T. bathonicus como T. gaudryi fueron referidos al género Eoneustes.

rejected.statement: A new specimen discovered in the 1980s was designated as the neotype to clarify anatomical details obscured by the original holotype cast.
rejected.quote: A new specimen discovered in the 1980s, comprising a lower jaw, a partial skull and a cervical vertebra, was made the neotype of the species, and has helped clear up some anatomical aspects previously obscured by the cast of the original holotype.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'A new specimen discovered in the 1980 s'
